text: The following question stood in the name of  Mr Desmond Choo –   23 To ask the Minister for Transport (a) how many substantiated cases of abuse committed against bus captains were there in each of the last three years; and (b) what further steps have been taken to improve the protection of bus captains in the course of their work.

speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye
text: asked the Minister for Transport (a) how many cases of assault against bus captains are reported annually in the past five years; (b) what are the penalties taken against the assailants; and (c) whether protective shields will be installed in our public buses to enhance protection.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: Members may have read from recent media reports on offenders who were jailed and fined for abusing our bus captains.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: These acts of kindness are very much appreciated by our public transport workers and they form part of the efforts to build a more gracious and considerate commuting culture.

speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye
text: I am the Executive Secretary of the National Transport Workers' Union.

speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye
text: I could see that the numbers have gradually come down.

speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye
text: But I think the recent cases of abuse are quite a concern.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: But as it stands now, as Mr Melvin Yong pointed out, the trend is in the right direction.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: So, we will continue this approach of working closely together with our tripartite partners and also to promote a more gracious, considerate commuting culture.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: That, I think, is going to be key.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: [Pursuant to Standing Order No 22(3), Written Answers to Question Nos 21, 25-35, 37-40, 44-48, 51, 54-59, 62, 69-71, 73-75, 81, 83, 86-90 and 92 on the Order Paper are reproduced in the Appendix.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The remaining Questions have been postponed to a later Sitting of Parliament or withdrawn.]
